error.not_a_file: This is a folder, not an image: {{path}}
error.unsupported: Spiegelmond cannot show this type of file: {{path}}
error.decode: The image cannot be shown, the file may be damaged: {{name}}

error.changed_meanwhile: The file changed after the preview, nothing was written: {{path}}
error.verify_failed: The check after writing failed; the original file was kept: {{path}}
error.broken: This file is damaged or not what its name says: {{path}}
error.no_codec: HEIC photos need the libheif decoder, which is missing next to Spiegelmond. Reinstall the program: {{name}}
error.trash_removable: Not deleted: removable drives have no Recycle Bin, and Spiegelmond never deletes for good. {{path}}
error.trash_network: Not deleted: network folders have no Recycle Bin, and Spiegelmond never deletes for good. {{path}}
error.trash_unavailable: Not deleted: the Recycle Bin is off or full for this drive, and Spiegelmond never deletes for good. {{path}}
error.trash_failed: Windows could not move the file to the Recycle Bin; it was not deleted: {{path}}
error.restore_failed: The file could not be brought back from the Recycle Bin; restore it there: {{path}}
error.restore_occupied: Another file now has this name, nothing was overwritten; the deleted one stays in the Recycle Bin: {{path}}
error.open_with_failed: The “Open with” window of Windows could not be shown: {{path}}
error.index_failed: The index of the photo archive could not be read or written: {{path}}
error.picture_changed: The change would have altered the picture; the file was kept as it was: {{path}}
error.too_many_files: More than 500 files at once; Spiegelmond works in batches: {{path}}
